title: HandoffTrigger

threshold.description: The threshold's key: five_hour, seven_day, fable.

label.description: The window as a sentence names it: 5-hour, weekly, Fable.

at.description: The utilisation, 0 to 1, at or above which the work should be handed on.

window.description: The account's window that met it.

utilisation.description: The window's utilisation, rounded to a whole percent; 1 for a refused window that reported none.

anyOf.description: The latest rate-limit verdict a run of the account reported for the window (plan.limit): allowed, warning (near the limit) or rejected (refused until the reset, whatever the utilisation reads).

verdict.description: The window's verdict: rejected when the provider is refusing, whatever the threshold.

description: The hand-off threshold the account handed from has met: which, on what window, and how full it reads.
